Library.Title: Playlists
Library.BoundCount: Number of scenarios this playlist is bound to
Library.Empty: No playlists yet. Click "Add playlist" and paste a Spotify, YouTube or YouTube Music link.
Library.DragHint: Drag a playlist onto a scenario to bind it, or onto a folder to move it. Drag a folder onto a scenario to bind every playlist inside it.

Panel.Title: Scenario Soundtracks
Panel.IdleHint: Click ▶ on a scenario or playlist to start the music for everyone.

Dialog.LinkHint: A Spotify playlist, album, artist or track link, a YouTube or YouTube Music playlist link, or a single YouTube video (which loops).
Dialog.Name: Name
Dialog.NameAuto: Leave empty to use the playlist's own title
Dialog.ShuffleHint: Start at a random track and play in random order.
Dialog.VolumeHint: Turn down playlists that are louder than the others. Everyone's Music slider still applies on top.
Dialog.IconHint: A Font Awesome class, e.g. fa-solid fa-ghost.
Dialog.ModeHint: With several playlists bound: pick a random one each time (never the same twice in a row), or go through them in order.
Dialog.DeleteFolderText: Delete the folder {name}? Its playlists and sub-folders move to the folder above.
Dialog.DeleteListText: Delete {name}? It is also removed from every scenario it is bound to.
Dialog.DeleteScenarioText: Delete the theme {name}? The playlists themselves are kept.

Automation.Title: Automation
Automation.Restore: Go back to the previous music when combat ends

Spotify.Connect: Connect your Spotify account to hear Spotify playlists
Spotify.ConnectToHear: This soundtrack is on Spotify. Click the Spotify button in the Playlists tab to connect your Spotify Premium account and hear it.
Spotify.NoClientId: The GM hasn't set a Spotify Client ID yet.
Spotify.NeedsHttps: Spotify only works when Foundry is opened over https:// (or on the host machine at http://127.0.0.1).
Spotify.PopupBlocked: The browser blocked the Spotify login window. Allow pop-ups for this site and try again.
Spotify.LoginTimeout: The Spotify login was not finished in time.
Spotify.InitError: Spotify can't play in this browser ({message}). The Foundry desktop app can't play Spotify – open Foundry in Chrome, Edge or Firefox instead.
Spotify.AuthError: Spotify rejected the login ({message}). Disconnect and connect Spotify again.
Spotify.PremiumRequired: Spotify only lets Premium accounts play music in other apps. Spotify soundtracks will stay silent for you.
Spotify.SetupHint: Create an app at developer.spotify.com/dashboard (Web API + Web Playback SDK), add the Redirect URI above to it, add every player's Spotify e-mail under "User Management", and paste the app's Client ID here. Each listener needs Spotify Premium and connects with the Spotify button in the Playlists tab.

Notify.GMOnly: Only the GM can control the soundtrack.
Notify.NoListsBound: No playlists are bound to "{name}" yet. Open the Scenario Soundtracks panel and drag a playlist onto it.
Notify.YouTubeError: YouTube refused to play this (error {code}). The video may be private, removed, or its owner doesn't allow it to be played outside YouTube.
Notify.InvalidLink: That link isn't a Spotify, YouTube or YouTube Music playlist, album, track or video.
Notify.FolderIntoItself: A folder can't be moved into itself.
Notify.SpotifyNotSetUp: Spotify isn't set up yet, so this playlist won't play. Add your Spotify Client ID in the Spotify section of this panel.

SpotifyClientId.Name: Spotify Client ID
SpotifyClientId.Hint: Needed for Spotify playlists. Setup instructions and the Redirect URI to use are in the Scenario Soundtracks control panel (button in the Playlists tab).

ShowToPlayers.Name: Show players what is playing
ShowToPlayers.Hint: Show the scenario and playlist name in the players' Playlists tab. Turn off to keep e.g. a "Boss fight" soundtrack a surprise.

Enabled.Name: Play soundtracks on this computer
Enabled.Hint: Turn off to mute Scenario Soundtracks for you only. To make them quieter, use the Music volume slider in the Playlists tab.

Keybindings.OpenPanel: Open the Scenario Soundtracks control panel
